name: ofsc-postman-collection
description: Oracle Field Service Cloud REST API Postman Collection with Plugin Development Tools

scripts.test: newman run './Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFSC) REST API - Full Collection.postman_collection.json' --environment './OFSC Basic Environment -TEST.postman_environment.json'
scripts.test:plugins: newman run './Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFSC) REST API - Full Collection.postman_collection.json' --folder Plugins
scripts.test:activities: newman run './Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFSC) REST API - Full Collection.postman_collection.json' --folder Activities
scripts.test:report: newman run './Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFSC) REST API - Full Collection.postman_collection.json' --reporters cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export ./reports/test-report.html

author: Saikumar Gudelly
